chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from al-Hasan ibn Ali from Yunus ibn Ya'qub from Umar ibn Yazid al-Basri from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) performed Hajj twenty times.
ai.seo_question: How many times did the Prophet Muhammad perform Hajj?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* establishes the Sunnah of the Prophet’s multiple pilgrimages, a point of scholarly discussion regarding whether these were the obligatory Hajj al-Idhtiyar or additional Hajj al-Nafila. It underscores the Prophet’s role as the perfect exemplar in ritual purity and devotion, reinforcing the legal principles of expiation discussed in the chapter. This frequency highlights the spiritual centrality of Hajj in the Prophetic tradition beyond the single obligatory duty.
